name: canary
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the Canary Claude Code plugin (Interactive Brokers portfolio analysis and trading research).

plugins.name: canary
plugins.description: Canary portfolio analysis and trading research for Interactive Brokers: account, positions, market data, sizing, broad-market regime context, portfolio stress checks, and preview-only order drafts. The MCP tool surface cannot place, modify, cancel, or transmit broker orders; explicit CLI broker writes remain gated by local trading status, preview tokens, and daemon policy. Requires the `canary` binary on PATH; see the project README for install and update instructions.
